nom: Clean & Clear Deep Action Exfoliating Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, greasy, or blackhead-prone skin, including some also prone to breakouts, widely report the wash leaves their face oil-free, clean, and less greasy after regular use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it's gentle enough for daily use without irritation, but one found the regular-use drying effect not ideal for sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with oily skin most often report the wash doesn't dry out their skin despite the exfoliating action; however, several reviewers, especially since a recent reformulation, describe the current version as drying with regular use, including on sensitive skin, with one recommending against using it more than twice a week to avoid stinging.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with oily, pimple- or blackhead-prone skin, report fewer breakouts, shrunken pores, and clearer skin with regular use; however, at least two reviewers say the reformulated version worsened their breakouts and acne, one calling the change to her skin dramatic.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or greasy skin consistently report the wash leaves their face oil-free and less greasy after just a few uses, though one reviewer felt the current formula wasn't granular enough to make a real difference for her oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Recent reformulation is weaker and less scrubby than the original
Cooling, tingly, minty sensation on application
Fine exfoliating texture without harsh beads
Cap or packaging breaks with normal use

extraits.texte: Okay I get it, get rid of the plastic beads but they shouldn’t have changed the original formula 😕 I’ve been using the original formula for YEAAARS and absolutely loved it, but sadly, took it for granted and didn’t stock up on it before it was discontinued. I tried the new formula for a few weeks and now I’m breaking out and my skin is dry even with my moisturizing routine. The new one doesn’t have the cooling feel and the “moodscent tech” is just really accentuated fragrance. For my girls that run hot and love the cooling of the original formula, try the Neutrogena deep clean foaming scrub, the ingredients are alllllmost identical. I follow the scrub with the Neutrogena cream cleanser, leave it on for a few minutes and rinse off with cool water for a refreshing clean. The neutrogena foaming scrub doesn’t *quite* match up to the original clean and clear scrub but it’s close. Disappointed to have to find a new go to, but nothing is promised forever I guess☹️

Cambiar a españolI like it very much is size and presentation, the aroma and the sensation of freshness that it leaves on the face is phenomenal, however it is not as granulated as I expected, it does not do the exfoliating effect I was needing, the scrub is very soft it can be used as Refreshing soap to wash the face but not to exfoliate, it is not special for oily skin as I thought. I have been applying it in the morning and at night, I will continue with my daily routine and in a few weeks I will return on the evolution day by day with the product

extraits.titre: “Decent Cleanser, But a Bit Drying for Sensitive Skin”
extraits.texte: “The Clean & Clear Deep Action Cleansing Solution works decently for a quick refresh, but it doesn’t quite deliver the deep clean I was expecting. While it leaves my skin feeling cool and tingly, it can be a bit drying with regular use. It’s good for occasional use, but not ideal for sensitive skin. I wish it had a more hydrating formula to balance out the cleansing effects.”

I’ve been using clean & clear for two weeks now and it’s been absolutely awful. I love the scent, it’s why I gave the product three stars, but other than that, it’s completely ruined my skin. I’d ordered clean & clear because I noticed my skin started getting more oily than usual and I stared experiencing stress breakouts, but this just made it so much worse.

extraits.titre: I have pretty oily skin that is sensitive and prone to break ...
extraits.texte: I have pretty oily skin that is sensitive and prone to break outs, especially in my chin and forehead area. I have been using this face wash for a week and am pleased so far. First of all the product is a nice size bottle I expect to last for awhile. It is easy to dispense the right amount. It says it cleans deep down to the pore and can remove makeup, I haven't used it to remove makeup but seems like it probably would work well. On the back it states it does not contain plastic microbeads (I don't think any products are allowed to contain them anymore). Whoever found the substitute for the microbeads did a great job because I can't tell a difference. This product does feel like it contains an exfoliating microbead of some sort in it. The beads (or whatever they are technically called) leave my skin feeling fresh. They also make it a little hard to use this product in the sink, it is much easier to rinse it all off in the shower. I haven't had any break outs at all and it hasn't overly dried my skin either. It leaves my face very clean and fresh feeling. Overall pleased and will continue to use this.

My skin is very greasy and lot of pimples and i started using Clean & Clear one year ago and is my favorite exfoliating for my skin i recomend this product a lot not a joke and i love it only 2 rinse on my face and all the greasy is gone on my face if you are a Person with acne o lot of greasy and pimples this wash body face is your best option i recomend this 10/10 :D

This facial scrub left my skin super soft from the first use. It has a light texture but just enough grains to cleanse without irritating. It helps remove impurities and leaves my face brighter. I use it two or three times a week and have noticed that my pores and blackheads have shrunk. Plus, it smells delicious and feels so refreshing. I love it!
